title: LP GRS Elemental & Compound Abundance - Prettyman et al. 2006
description: Global lunar abundance maps of MgO, Al2O3, SiO2, CaO, TiO2, FeO, K, Th, and U derived by linear spectral unmixing of Lunar Prospector gamma ray spectra (Prettyman et al. 2006, JGR, doi:10.1029/2005JE002656). PDS bundle lp-l-grs-5-elem-abundance-v1. Available at 2, 5, and 20 degree quasi-equal-area resolution.
